snippet.title: BioEden - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
#BioEden launches September 3 on PC! Wishlist on all platforms, play the demo and preorder on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265840?utm_campaign=BE_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=YouTube#buy

Step into your next cozy management game with BioEden! 

Heal a barren world with care: manage resources, build sustainable networks and bring wonderful animal species back to life. 🍃
